hookPolicies.notes: Claude hooks remain native until another tool exposes a stable repo-level equivalent.

Codex supports repo-local hooks (.codex/hooks.json, 12 documented events, trust-gated); DorkOS maps 11 of them (Interrupt has no Claude spelling). Generated from canonical .claude/settings.json via the vendored CANONICAL_TO_CODEXCLI_EVENT_NAMES map, in the documented { description, hooks } shape. Prefer the standalone hooks.json over inline config.toml (openai/codex#17532 breaks interactive SessionStart/Stop).
